_README: Long-form YouTube videos. kind:'mix' = themed two-hour mixes (featured on the homepage). kind:'album' = full album front-to-back. Adding one = one object here; the homepage strip and longplays.html both read this file. 'id' is the YouTube video id.

videos.name: Wining & Dining
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom's jazziest, most romantic cuts from TOUCHÉ PUSSYCAT and WONDER BLACK WOMAN, laid over a golden-hour drive down the Palisades Parkway. Pour something, dim the lights, let it ride.

videos.name: Kizomba 💃
videos.blurb: Nearly two hours of Late Blooom's kizomba, zouk and konpa from the COMME ÇA? trilogy, drifting over Paris in a hot air balloon at golden hour. Slow, warm, close.

videos.name: Caribbean 🌴
videos.blurb: Nearly two hours of Late Blooom's island and Afro-groove cuts from 2 GOOD X and AFROMANTIC ANTISOCIALITE, riding the bow of a catamaran into a Caribbean sunset. Turquoise water, golden light, steady sail.

videos.name: Meditation 🌙
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom's calmest music — CENTER & BALANCE, CENTER + BALANCE Vol. 2, UNLOCKING THE SON and NARROW + SUPPLE — from the cockpit of a ship drifting toward sunrise over Earth. For yoga, meditation, study, sleep.

videos.name: Funstrumental 🎛️
videos.scene: Vespa Ride on the Amalfi Coast
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom instrumentals — BLOWN AWAY YET?, LOWKEY KINDA LIT: 70s and the upbeat cuts of NARROW + SUPPLE — riding a vintage Vespa along the Amalfi coast at golden hour. Work, cook, drive, vibe.

videos.name: Empowered 💪
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom's most affirming songs — WONDER BLACK WOMAN and BLOWN AWAY YET? — watching the sun rise above a sea of clouds from a mountain summit. Morning fuel.

videos.name: Latin / Mundo 🌹
videos.sub: 2 Hours of Cásate × Reina de Drama
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom en español — CÁSATE and REINA DE DRAMA — drifting along Havana's Malecón as the sun goes down. Flamenco fire, boleros, drama.

videos.name: pissed chick rock 🔥
videos.sub: 2 Hours of Alt Rock with Attitude
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom with an attitude — VEXXXED and REALITY CHECK, PLEASE? — on a motorcycle down an empty desert highway at sunset. Explicit. Loud. Cathartic.

videos.name: Kizomba Lusófona 💃
videos.sub: 2 Hours of Comme Ça Deep Cuts
videos.blurb: Nearly two hours of Late Blooom in Portuguese and French — the Português set plus the Comme Ça? kizomba, zouk and konpa cuts you haven't heard in the other mix — from a beach towel on warm Caribbean sand, boats bobbing in a turquoise bay. Slow it down.

videos.name: Taco Tuesday 🌮
videos.sub: 2 Hours en Español · Latin Deep Cuts
videos.blurb: Two hours of Late Blooom en español — the Taco Tuesday set from CÁSATE plus the REINA DE DRAMA and L8 NITE cuts that didn't make the Havana mix — beside a crackling bonfire on a moonlit Caribbean beach. Cook, pour, linger.

videos.name: Meditation Vol. 2 🌙
videos.blurb: Two more hours of Late Blooom's calmest music — the rest of CENTER + BALANCE Vol. 2, UNLOCKING THE SON and the slow half of NARROW + SUPPLE — from a window seat cruising above golden sunset clouds. For yoga, meditation, study, sleep, long flights.

videos.name: SALT + GLASS
videos.blurb: The whole SALT + GLASS album, front to back, gliding across a mirror-still salt flat as the sun comes up. Out now.

videos.name: CENTER + BALANCE, Vol. 3
videos.blurb: Twenty-two B-words to breathe with, from BALANCE to BENEVOLENT, over a glass-still alpine lake at first light. Out October 9, 2026 everywhere.

videos.name: AFROMANTIC ANTISOCIALITE
videos.blurb: Afro-romantic grooves for people who'd rather stay in — fireflies, candlelight and a couple under the moon.

videos.name: CENTER & BALANCE
videos.blurb: Twenty-four C-words to breathe, stretch and settle with, over red-rock desert yoga at sunset. For meditation, yoga, study and sleep.

videos.name: CÁSATE CONMIGO, BENI!
videos.blurb: Flamenco fire, boleros and Latin drama en español, front to back.

videos.name: VEXXXED
videos.blurb: Alt rock with attitude. Loud, sharp, cathartic. Explicit.

videos.name: CENTER + BALANCE, Vol. 2
videos.blurb: Twenty-three A-words to breathe, stretch and settle with. For meditation, yoga, study and sleep.

videos.name: TOUCHÉ PUSSYCAT, Vol. 1
videos.blurb: Jazzy neo-soul with a wink — thirty-five cuts for a long golden-hour drive through the mountains. Pour something, roll the windows down.

videos.name: COMME ÇA? Vol. 1
videos.blurb: Kizomba and Afro-Lusophone grooves for a slow jeep ride down the Angolan coast, ocean on one side, jungle on the other.

videos.name: COMME ÇA? Vol. 2
videos.scene: Moonlit Beach Bar in St. Barth
videos.blurb: Kizomba slow grooves for a packed dance floor on the sand in St. Barth, moon glowing over the water, bodies close.

videos.name: COMME ÇA? Vol. 3
videos.blurb: A slow night walk through the streets of Salvador da Bahia: drums on one corner, dancing on the next, the city alive around you.

videos.name: TOUCHÉ PUSSYCAT, Vol. 2
videos.blurb: Jazzy neo-soul with a wink, set inside a late-night club: congas, kit, sax, clarinet, and the singer dancing with her back to the room.

videos.name: IT BEGINS HERE
videos.blurb: Where the story starts. An outdoor dance floor at dusk: string lights, a peach-and-pink sky, a couple in a suit and a gown, kids twirling around them.

videos.name: 2 GOOD X
videos.blurb: Rolling past the painted walls of St. Maarten — conch shells, pelicans, portraits and turquoise waves in the Caribbean sun.

videos.name: UNLOCKING THE SON
videos.blurb: The whole UNLOCKING THE SON album, front to back, rising into the cosmos.

videos.name: LOWKEY KINDA LIT: 70S
videos.blurb: The whole LOWKEY KINDA LIT: 70s album by Late Blooom, front to back.

videos.scene: Driving the West Side Highway at Sunset
videos.blurb: The whole THE WONDER BLACK WOMAN, Vol. 1 album by Late Blooom, front to back.

videos.blurb: The whole BLOWN AWAY YET? album by Late Blooom, front to back.
